name: Hand axe
tip: Light and nimble — great for softwood, easy to under-power hardwood.

name: Nordic splitting axe
tip: Wide wedge converts force into split; forgiving on knotty rounds.

name: Camp axe
tip: Balanced all-rounder — a solid default for learning the power slider.

name: Maul
tip: Heavy maul: overswing risk is high; aim for hardwood sweet spots.
